source.upstream: references/styles/01_通用母版/艺术表现/立体剪纸风.md

visual_language.direction: layered paper-cut craft, scissor-cut shapes stacked in tactile sheets with soft inter-layer shadows, crisp slightly-irregular cut edges, no outlines, matte paper grain, warm hand-made depth, cozy composed whitespace

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以剪切片层层堆叠、层间软影与哑光纸纹的触感语言,做文化民俗、节日、儿童与可持续议题的温暖表达;温暖而不幼稚,层次即强调
legacy_payload.visual_direction: layered paper-cut craft, scissor-cut shapes stacked in tactile sheets with soft inter-layer shadows, crisp slightly-irregular cut edges, no outlines, matte paper grain, warm hand-made depth, cozy composed whitespace

canvas.background: 燕麦衬纸层 #E8E0D5(背板层显出呼吸位)
canvas.composition: 每元素是一张「纸片」叠在下一层之上;底层背板纸透出做留白;顶层小切花点缀
canvas.density: low-to-medium,cozy 而成构图——背板纸透出即留白

color_palette.neutral: #3D3229(深暖褐墨层:文字与最深层剪影)
color_palette.rule: 每色即一层纸——层叠与遮挡承担强调而非面积比例;小前层压大背层同样读作主导;全部哑光,禁荧光

typography.title: 温暖圆润无衬线(Nunito / 思源黑体 Rounded 气质),可坐在剪纸横幅形上
typography.body: 同族正文,行距宽绰,亲和不严厉
typography.labels: 小标签同族;可做「剪纸标签形」载体

layout_patterns: 标题区 = 剪纸横幅形(banner sheet)托起标题字,横幅层压在衬纸上
内容 = 剪片卡阵:每卡一层纸,卡与卡之间露出背板层做留白,层间 8-12% 软投影
章节页 = 大幅单色剪纸母图(如层叠山形/花形)+ 顶层小切花点缀
流程页 = 剪纸箭头/步进层,每步一层纸由低到高
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 层叠即强调:任何重点都通过「放上一层纸」表达;全场禁描边——形状只靠切边定义
negative_prompt: no outlines or strokes — shapes are defined by cut edges only
no flat digital illustration look; every element must read as a cut sheet
no glossy or fluorescent surfaces; matte paper grain throughout
layer shadows stay soft (8-12%), never hard brutalist offsets
legacy_payload.palette_family: earthy-dusty(莫兰迪纸艺)/ macaron(儿童粉彩);源规格颜色行为分离——层叠纪律是风格本体,HEX 可被品牌侧替换

visual_elements.allowed: 剪切片层叠,层间软影,哑光纸纹,顶层小切花,剪纸横幅与标签形
visual_elements.avoid: 描边轮廓;平面数字插画感;光泽表面;硬偏移影

rendering_constraints: Inter-layer soft drop shadow (8-12%) is core — the one style where layered shadow is the point.
Slightly irregular cut edges; shapes read as paper, not vector.

recommendation_features.feature_defaults_basis: family-prior (U3)：机械默认按家族语义先验替换，来源记录在案
